text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The original Xbox was released in 2001 as Microsoft's first home video game console. It introduced features uncommon on consoles at the time, including a built-in hard drive, broadband networking through Xbox Live, and PC-based hardware architecture. The system's library included Halo: Combat Evolved, Fable, Forza Motorsport, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, and Ninja Gaiden. Xbox Live helped establish online console gaming as a major feature. The console competed with Sony's PlayStation 2 and Nintendo GameCube while creating the foundation for Microsoft's future Xbox platforms.
